opennyai_summary.decision:
The impugned orders dated 10-08-2017 and 22-08-2017 passed by the High Court at Calcutta,
whereby the M.A.T. No.1558/2017 and M.A.T. No.2029/2016 filed by the appellants  herein were dismissed, are under challenge before this Court.
, the matters are required to be remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration.
In view of the above, the impugned orders passed by the High Court are set aside and the matters are remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration in the light of the Judgment in the case of Indore Development Authority (supra).
5. It is clarified that all contentions including proposal of settlement are kept open to be raised by both the parties as may be legally permissible.
6. The appeals stand disposed of in above terms.
Leave granted.
3. Pending applications, if any, shall also stand disposed of.
